title: Light and dark modes for Scribe
summary: The Scribe writing studio can now switch between a bright light look and the familiar dark look using the sun and moon button. Only that workspace changes — the rest of the site stays dark. Colored word highlights still work in both.

title: Compose: a new way to build components
summary: Compose makes it faster to build and update interface components without rebuilding their behavior, appearance, and accessibility from scratch. Scholomance's existing creative tools can now work behind one shared system, and pages can be upgraded gradually without disrupting the rest of the site.

title: Recent updates list opens on the homepage
summary: A new section on the homepage now shows recent updates alongside the Enter button, in its own panel with the same look as the rest of the site.

title: Safe add-update command
summary: Updates can be added with a single command. The system validates the file first so a bad edit can never overwrite the updates list.

title: Consistent styling across the site
summary: The styling for the updates section is now shared, so other parts of the site can use the same look without duplicating the stylesheet.

title: Pages now share one stable layout
summary: The layout code was moved to a shared file so the homepage, the combat page, and the DivWand pages all use the same structure.

title: Unified metrics on the Read page
summary: The stats panel on the Read page now matches the Song Stats engine, so word density and rhythm appear as one consistent set of measurements.

title: Flow and alignment scores
summary: Song Stats now shows an estimated flow (how each line lands relative to the beat) and an alignment score. When there is not enough info, the score is labeled provisional.

title: Two rhyme density scores
summary: Rhyme Density now reports two numbers: one for how often rhymes repeat and one for how far apart they are.

title: Word variety with sample warning
summary: Word variety now counts unique base words and warns when a sample is too short to give a reliable score.

title: Technical Density range
summary: Song Stats now includes a Technical Density range with clear upper limits and a note that the score does not measure artistic quality.

title: Leximancy part-of-speech grouping
summary: The Leximancy view now groups words by part of speech and suggests writing techniques based on live dictionary data.

title: Antonym relations added
summary: Opposite-word relations from the English WordNet are now in the Scholomance dictionary, so Leximancy can find opposites in the word graph.

title: Persistent word graph
summary: A persistent word graph is now the backbone of Leximancy, giving fast access to synonyms, broader terms, and related words.

title: Live related-words panel
summary: The Leximancy screen now fetches related words live, with loading indicators and a way to pin suggestions so you do not lose your place.

title: Truesight drives visualizer colors
summary: The visualizer now uses Truesight to control school colors and detail, keeping its appearance consistent across the experience.

title: Smoother, more consistent mandala motion
summary: Mandala stage motion is now driven by consistent timing instead of free-running decorative loops.

title: Lyrics and visuals now stay in sync
summary: Karaoke highlights now follow the same timing as the visual motion, so lyrics and effects advance together.

title: Clearer release cards
summary: Release cards were rebuilt so it is clearer where each release came from, what it costs, and how to tell it apart.

title: Creative tools now work together consistently
summary: Wand, DivWand, and PixelBrain now share one way of describing their abilities, keeping the creative tools consistent as they evolve.

title: Album library navigation
summary: The visualizer album list and navigation make the catalog feel like a library you can browse, not a flat list of tracks.

title: Per-album pages
summary: Each album now has its own page with art, lyrics, and playback controls, so it feels like its own room.

title: Stacked PixelBrain layers
summary: PixelBrain layers can now be stacked and inspected together, keeping a record of where each layer came from.

title: School colors now stay consistent
summary: School colors now follow consistent rules, so the glow stays coherent instead of freeform.

title: Sound signatures now remain consistent
summary: The same sound signature now follows each track through Listen, the visualizer, and the gear systems, so every part of the site recognizes it consistently.

title: One workflow for creating game assets
summary: Game asset work now flows through one workflow that sends each task to the right tool (SCDL, PixelBrain, Wand, or DivWand).

title: Explore music through its sound spectrum
summary: The core of the Listen feature now lets you explore music through its sound spectrum, not just a flat equalizer strip.

title: Polaris Forest sound walk
summary: The Polaris Forest now has a sound walkthrough that responds with light and tone as you walk the path.

title: Smoother transitions between screens
summary: A new system coordinates transitions between screens, keeping the journey from the homepage into the rest of Scholomance visually coherent.

title: Deliberate enemy AI
summary: Combat enemies now decide through a council-style process, so they act with purpose instead of just random aggression.

title: Verse drives combat power
summary: Combat now ties how well a verse holds together to how strong the spell is, so grammar and rhythm become the weapon.

title: PicturebookMud display upgrade
summary: The PicturebookMud on-screen display was upgraded to match the look of the rest of the Scholomance screens.
